inputs.prompt: Reimagine this as an upscale restaurant marketing photograph of a private dining room. Keep the room, tables, chairs, doorway and layout exactly as they are - do not change the architecture. Remove all overlay UI chrome - no profile photo, no username, no timestamp, no close button, no navigation arrows, no watermark text. Replace the bright TV content on the wall with a warm ambient scene, soft abstract warm light. Populate the empty foreground tables with additional seated guests dining and mid-conversation, keep the two guests already walking through as candid background motion. Warm the overall lighting to an inviting golden restaurant glow. Photorealistic documentary event photography, natural candid moment.
